name: manuscript-guard-landing-video
description: The landing page's short video of Vord, made with HyperFrames

scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -v error -i renders/vord-raw.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -level:v 4.0 -r 30 -movflags +faststart -map_metadata -1 ../../web/landing/media/vord.mp4
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run encode && npm run poster && npm run vtt
